LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS
AS ON 2.2.1968

blocks.html:
1.Smt. Indira GandhiPrime Minister(All Ministries/Departments not specified below).
2.Shri Pranab Kumar MukherjeeMinister of Finance.
3.Shri P.V. Narasimha RaoMinister of External Affairs.
4.Shri P.C. SethiMinister of Home Affairs.
5.Shri Shiv ShankarMinister of Energy.
6.Shri R. VenkataramanMinister of Defence.
7.Shri A.B. Ghosh Khan ChaudhuriMinister of Railways.
8.Shri S.B. ChavanMinister of Planning.
9.Shri Jagannath KaushalMinister of Law,Justice and Company Affairs.
10.Shri Voarandra PatilMinister of Labour & Rehabilitation.
11.Shri K. Vijaya Bhaskara ReddyMinister without portfolio (Cement Saftly building charge of the M/S Shipping and Transport).
12.Shri Vasant SatheMinister of Chemicals and Fertilizers.
13.Shri B. ShankaranandMinister of Health & Family Welfare.
14.Shri A.P. SharmaMinister of Communications.
15.Shri Bhismu Narain SinghMinister of Civil Supplies & Supply.
16.Rao Birandra SinghMinister of Agriculture.
17.Shri Buta SinghMinister of Parliamentary Affairs, Sports and Works and Housing.
18.Shri Vishwanath Pratap SinghMinister of Commerce.
19.Shri Narayan Datt TiwardMinister of Industry and Steel and Mines.
